name: China Petroleum Engineering Corporation
summary: China Petroleum Engineering Corporation provides energy and chemical engineering services. The company is involved in onshore and offshore oil and gas engineering design consulting, engineering contracting, construction and manufacturing, and operation and maintenance. It also engages in onshore and offshore oil and gas pipeline projects, chemical petroleum storage facilities, LNG receiving terminals and other engineering construction, marine pipeline survey and measurement, design and construction, and transportation of hydrogen and CO2.
